$comment: Canonical course document format (task 1.2 contract freeze; realized by shared/snowboard/course.js in task 3.1). The SAME JSON document and its sha256 hash bind render and simulation on client and server. Linear centerline interpolation and bilinear height interpolation, clamped at edges, are identical in both runtimes. Cosmetic noise must live outside the legal corridor or be part of this sampler.

format.hash: sha256 hex of the canonical JSON (sorted keys, no whitespace) of this document WITHOUT the hash field
format.rulesVersion: integer, must equal contract.identity.rulesVersion at load time
format.corridorHalfWidth: number, legal corridor half width; lateral samples span [-corridorHalfWidth, +corridorHalfWidth]
format.groomedHalfWidth: number, shoulder penalty begins outside this half width

centerline.x: number, world-space center x at s
centerline.width: number, rideable full width at s (must be <= 2*corridorHalfWidth)

grid.sValues: number[] ascending, uniform by gridStepMeters, first = 0, last = lengthMeters
grid.uValues: number[] ascending, uniform by lateralStepMeters, symmetric about 0
grid.height: number[][] indexed [sIndex][uIndex], surface height in meters (y), finite
grid.surface: number[][] indexed [sIndex][uIndex], integer tags: 0 = groomed, 1 = snowbank (2 = rock, 3 = ice reserved)

ramps.lipHeight: number, added surface height on the lip

recoveryPoints.segment: integer, checkpoint segment index this point belongs to (gates with index <= segment are considered earned)

validation: lengthMeters equals contract.course.lengthMeters and grid last s equals it exactly
sValues uniform with step gridStepMeters; uValues uniform, symmetric, spanning +/-corridorHalfWidth
centerline s ascending and total coverage equals [0, lengthMeters]
every gate index is present exactly once, ordered by index, s ascending
recovery point s is >= the obstacle it recovers from and its segment's earned gates are never skipped by the reset
all heights finite; surface tags are integers 0..1 (2..3 reserved); hash recomputation matches document.hash
gate acceptance altitude spans surface height to surface height + contract.simulation.gateAltitudeCeiling

interpolation.centerX: linear between adjacent centerline samples, clamped at ends
interpolation.height: bilinear over (s, u) on the grid, clamped at edges; identical constants in JS and Elixir
interpolation.slope: gSlope = clamp(-(h(s+step)-h(s-step)) / (2*step), 0, gradeMax), sampled from the same grid

$comment-sample: The sample is a minimal structurally-valid document for parser/loader tests; it is not the playable course and carries no hash (the real course export in 3.1 computes and pins it).
